records.title: Long-LRM: Long-Sequence Large Reconstruction Model for Wide-Coverage Gaussian Splats
records.reason: Long-LRM combines Mamba/Transformer blocks and token merging/pruning to make dense-view 3D reconstruction feasible under memory limits; results emphasize training time/memory and reconstruction, not LLM inference. The long-sequence architecture connection is exploratory.

records.title: MARIO: MAth Reasoning with code Interpreter Output - A Reproducible Pipeline
records.reason: MARIO is a reproducible math-reasoning pipeline that uses interpreter outputs. Its contribution is task accuracy/reproducibility; it does not optimize inference systems despite a remote memory-optimization citation.
